title: 국립공원공단법 시행령 / queue:ADDENDUM:35804:20251001:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Presidential Decree No. 35804, October 1, 2025>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation: Provided, That among the Presidential Decrees amended pursuant to Article 5 of this Addendum, provisions amending Presidential Decrees promulgated before the enforcement of this Decree but not yet in force shall enter into force on the respective enforcement dates of those Presidential Decrees.

Articles 2 through 4
Omitted.

Article 5 (Amendments to Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) through (4) Omitted.

(5) The Enforcement Decree of the Korea National Park Service Act shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 8, the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 10 (1), paragraph (2) of the same Article, Article 11 (1) and (2), the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 12, the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 13, and Article 14 (1) and (2), respectively, "Minister of Environment" shall be replaced with "Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment."

(6) through <80> Omitted.
